items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview

ctx.x: Well, at the time, I was listening to a whole lot of music -- records -- almost in every neighborhood they had little penny vendors, little restaurants, you walked past, and you could hear all the music you want. Basie, Benny Goodman, Slam Stewart, Slim and Slam ... oh my God, so many good musicians -- naturally Duke was at the top.
Pops. Oh, boy, Chick Webb with Ella.
